title: CEFR classic PDF family (2001 / Waystage / Threshold)
description: Conservative shared defaults for pre-Companion CEFR PDFs. All extraction features default OFF so page_png jobs (Waystage/Threshold) never inherit figure/multipage paths by accident. Enable features only on markdown jobs (e.g. cefr-en-2001 job.json). Profile output.mode is markdown; Waystage/Threshold override to page_png at job level.
